common_cover: intersection of exactly-one-minute intrasection rows with valid frozen state and valid fit for every primary compared candidate; failures on common rows count against model
equivalence_note: F1 raw affine, F2 centered affine, and F3 centered-scaled affine span the same affine function class under exact least squares. They retain separate coefficient/conditioning evidence; their physical vector fields must agree within floating-point tolerance or scoring stops.
rk_execution: Chunked scipy.solve_ivp(method=RK45) over independent flattened affine systems; each trajectory retains its own frozen coefficients and state, with one-minute span and Test011 rtol/scale-aware atol. Chunking changes solver batching only, not mathematical coupling (derivative is block diagonal).
selection: No scalar score. Identify Pareto/tradeoffs across endpoint/tail/directional/transition/numerical/perturbation/conditioning/domain criteria. A best continuous candidate requires zero material explosions, materially reduced Q99.9/max/perturbation, acceptable endpoint/state accuracy, and no hidden row removal.
